research_question: How can we improve estimates of particulate organic matter (POM) flux from in-situ optics using paired UVP particle size distribution and CTD physical oceanography data?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are estimating particulate organic matter flux using data from the RV METEOR cruise M160 (November-December 2019) near the Cape Verde archipelago. Could you find the PANGAEA dataset identifiers for the Underwater Vision Profiler 5 (UVP5) particle data and the corresponding CTD physical oceanography measurements (temperature and oxygen) collected during this cruise?

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have the dataset identifiers (10.1594/PANGAEA.924375 for the UVP5 data and 10.1594/PANGAEA.943432 for the CTD data), please retrieve the tabular data records so we can access the particle concentrations, water temperature, and oxygen profiles.
